user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: City Construction Site. An active construction site: a tall tower crane slowly slewing over a half-built concrete frame wrapped in scaffolding, a cement mixer truck with rotating drum, striped barriers and cones, a stack of steel beams, a portable site office, dirt mounds with an excavator, safety signage, and floodlights on masts illuminating the work zone. Style: industrial stylized. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
